cases.disposition_reason: The checkpoint is the open New workspace environment key form from open_env_form in src/bin/jackin/screens/config.rs, width 70, after the key DATABASE_URL and the masked plain value are typed, before Save. Pressing a on the workspace DATABASE_URL row opens that form because build_rows skips the workspace header. The shot is 120×40, then 80×24, and the narrow shot is taken before the terminal returns to 120×40. The focused field paints Theme mask bullets, and duplicate-secret-value and pw-fixture-only stay absent. FormDialog::take_result in src/ui/layers.rs closes on FormAction::Save, and the form is popped before save_env runs. save_env calls with_top for DATABASE_URL already exists in this scope, which does not reach the closed form, and it returns before push. After Save the form is closed, that error string is absent, and exactly one DATABASE_URL row remains, still 16 asterisks from mask() in src/bin/jackin/domain/workspace.rs. Adding FIELD_TOKEN paints FIELD_TOKEN · added · save to apply and the list masks it as ************t-91. Editing LOG_LEVEL to info paints LOG_LEVEL · updated · save to apply and four asterisks. Scope for FIELD_TOKEN chooses role backend and paints FIELD_TOKEN moved to role backend. The workspace section no longer lists FIELD_TOKEN. Role: backend lists it, still masked. Delete environment variable LOG_LEVEL? focuses Cancel through Dialog::destructive. Activating Delete paints Removed LOG_LEVEL · u restores until save, and u is not pressed. Ctrl+S opens Save workspace from open_preview in src/bin/jackin/screens/editor.rs. The focused line contains Cancel. Clean up & save… is absent. Confirm Save calls start_save, which schedules WorkspaceSaved at 900 ms, and the wall clock reaches Workspace payments-platform saved. Reopening Environments shows FIELD_TOKEN under Role: backend, still masked. LOG_LEVEL is absent. DATABASE_URL is one row and pw-fixture-only is absent. STRIPE_KEY still shows the [op] reference mask. GH_TOKEN still shows $GH_TOKEN. The workspace name is still payments-platform.
